data.rationale: The proposal follows the same IMDb → Rotten Tomatoes → mail sequence and the same subject and body templates. It differs in three ways: it adds cookie-banner steps, it ends with "save or send the draft" instead of "do not send, click Discard", and it uses the parameters recipient_email and recipient_name where the true workflow has a single friend parameter (the address is {friend}@example.com). The draft/send ending is a risky mistake, and the split recipient parameters are slightly inconsistent, but the spec is otherwise concrete enough to automate.
